name: IDC / TCIA RIDER Lung PET-CT: incidental ECG-gated cardiac CTA studies
tier: T1/T2 (7 CCTA or cardiac-morphology/congenital studies = T1; 4 gated chest CTA/triple rule-out studies = T2)
n_scans: 13 unique PatientIDs / 14 studies / 16 series with usable contrast gated volumes, after removing duplicate IDs and non-contrast series. Probably about 12 distinct people, since one 81-year-old woman seems to have 3 studies. The collection also has about 30 more 'CT CARDIAC CTA CORONARY' studies that hold only a timing-bolus or localizer, with no CTA volume (unusable).
format: DICOM (GE LightSpeed VCT, 0.625 mm, 0.45-0.59 mm pixels; 'SS Segment' series are multi-phase stacks of 10 phases, 1380-2864 files)
license: CC BY 3.0 (from IDC license_short_name). Commercial use and derivatives allowed with attribution.
steps_to_access: pip install idc-index; then either (a) s5cmd --no-sign-request --endpoint-url https://s3.amazonaws.com run IDC_T1T2_manifest.s5cmd (rider lines), or (b) idc download <SeriesInstanceUID> per row of IDC_T1T2_series.csv, or (c) python: IDCClient().download_from_selection(seriesInstanceUID=[...], downloadDir='out'). No login.
provenance/duplicates: TCIA RIDER Lung PET-CT. IMPORTANT: almost every patient appears twice under two different RIDER-IDs with the same age, sex and date. Pixel-identical on test: RIDER-2522924559 vs RIDER-1836251657 (174/174 slices with identical PixelData md5). Pairs: 2522924559=1836251657(+1344035392 for the TRO), 2551730224=2828741099, 2109273429=2923759101, 4767464492=4838364823, 2061910848=3084258403, 2623772839=3333320954. The manifest keeps one of each. Not related to ImageCAS (USA, 2005-06).
verified: Downloaded and opened 9 series (then deleted them): 2522924559 SS Segment 345 (aorta/LA ~500-570 HU, clear coronary CTA image); 1344035392 TRO cine (75cc Visipaque, 400-490 HU); 2267469717 gated CTA chest (~450 HU); 2061910848 (150cc Omni350, ~420 HU); 2551730224 (500 HU); 2109273429 (16-year-old male, post-op heart, ~350 HU); 2019259100 (10 phases x 57 slices at 2.5 mm, ~320 HU); 4767464492 multi-phase 1380 (~230 HU, weaker enhancement). NON-contrast (excluded): 2623772839 both 'SS Cine' series (calcium score) and 2266952716. Not downloaded (>1 GB, contrast is inferred from the protocol): 2416820556, 7701645091, 1822442188, 2991299498; 2857227961 (842 MB; Visipaque tag in header, pixels not checked). The DICOM headers carry no CardiacSynchronization or ContrastBolus tags on most series (anonymised); gating is inferred from GE 'SnapShot Segment/Cine 30-75 BPM' protocol names.
notes: Small but genuinely new, independent T1 coronary CTAs with an open CC BY licence. 3114425590 has only 67 slices at 2.5 mm (partial). 1450633088 (56-slice cine, age 000Y) is left out. The multi-phase SS Segment stacks must be split by phase (files share z positions, about 10 phases each) before annotation; TriggerTime is blank, so split by InstanceNumber/AcquisitionTime.

name: IDC / TCIA NSCLC Radiogenomics: gated chest CTA
n_scans: 2 patients / 2 studies (AMC-015, AMC-027), each with best-diastolic and best-systolic 1 mm reconstructions (4 series)
steps_to_access: idc download 1.3.6.1.4.1.14519.5.2.1.4334.1501.226290841276881230606366131024 (and the other 3 UIDs in IDC_T1T2_series.csv), or use the s5cmd manifest lines.
provenance/duplicates: TCIA NSCLC Radiogenomics (Stanford/Palo Alto VA). Independent of ImageCAS.
verified: Downloaded AMC-027 'BEST DIASTOLIC 69 %' (336 files, 177 MB) and deleted it after checking: ContrastBolusAgent Isovue 370 (123 ml); ScanOptions TP69PC, OSCRATEAVG052BPM, BESTPHASE_DIAS (Siemens ECG-gated); ProtocolName GATED_CHEST_CTA; blood pool 375-420 HU; image shows an enhanced aortic root and heart.
notes: ECG-gated chest CTA covering the whole thorax: coronaries are visible but this is not a dedicated CCTA.

name: IDC / TCIA VAREPOP-APOLLO: TAVR cardiac CTA
n_scans: 1 patient (AP-26JK) / 1 study / 3 series (0-100% multiphase 256 matrix, BestDiast 59%, BestSyst 31%)
verified: Downloaded the BestDiast 59% series (459 files, 243 MB) and deleted it after checking: ProtocolName TAVR; ScanOptions TP59PC, OSCRATEAVG075BPM, BESTPHASE_DIAS; contrast visible in the image (aortic root, LV); blobs 250-350 HU. The study also has a 'Chin thru Pelvis' TAVR run-off and a Fl_CaSc calcium score (not included).

name: IDC / TCGA-OV: gated constrictive-pericarditis cardiac CT
n_scans: 1 patient (TCGA-25-1328) / 1 gated delayed series of 25 slices at 3 mm
verified: Downloaded through the s5cmd manifest (25 files) and deleted. ScanOptions TP65PC (ECG-gated), Protocol 02_0_Constrictive_Pericarditis, blood pool ~250-280 HU (delayed phase).
notes: 3 mm, 75 mm coverage, delayed phase: low value for coronary annotation.

name: IDC aggregate: CTPA / CT angiography of chest or aorta inside cancer and COVID collections
n_scans: about 316 studies / 293 patients across 24 collections (heuristic text match on Study/SeriesDescription). Largest: covid_19_ny_sbu 135 studies/124 patients (CC BY 4.0, ~107 GB for all series); midrc_ricord_1b 32/32 (CC BY-NC 4.0); lidc_idri 25/25 (CC BY 3.0); midrc_ricord_1a 24/21 (CC BY-NC 4.0); acrin_nsclc_fdg_pet 19/19; covid_19_ar 17/17; rider_pilot 10/5; varepop_apollo 10/6; eay131 8/8; the rest have 6 or fewer each.
license: Mostly CC BY 3.0/4.0. NON-COMMERCIAL: midrc_ricord_1a and midrc_ricord_1b (CC BY-NC 4.0). Other NC collections in IDC (nsclc_radiomics*, phantom_fda = CC BY-NC 3.0) have no relevant CTA.
steps_to_access: Same idc-index/s5cmd method; select series with duckdb on IDCClient().index (e.g. collection_id='covid_19_ny_sbu' AND StudyDescription ILIKE '%PULMONARY ANGIO%' AND SeriesDescription ILIKE 'CHEST 1.25%' gives 101 thin axial CTPA series from 95 patients, 12.5 GB).
verified: Downloaded one covid_19_ny_sbu CTPA series ('CHEST 1.25 MM', 233 files, 123 MB) and deleted it: ContrastBolusAgent NON IONIC IV, 1.25 mm, enhanced vessels ~200-240 HU (pulmonary-arterial timing). Counts are from index queries only.
notes: midrc_ricord_1a study 'CARDIAC CORONARY CTA' (MIDRC-RICORD-1A-440808-000007) only holds a 3 mm thoraco-abdominal arterial series (NominalPercentageOfCardiacPhase 75), so it counts as T3, not T1. Broader heuristic for ANY contrast chest CT in IDC: ~4,100 studies / ~3,600 patients in 58 collections, but most are venous-phase oncology staging scans.
